## Codex execution contract

**CGS-18 studio-testing and evidence contract:** Use available native tools rather than assuming Claude-specific execution. Preserve current host permissions and prior explicit user authorization; unavailable questions use plain conversation and unanswered decisions are not consent. Native delegation is independent only when a child actually runs; otherwise disclose an in-session fallback. Use actual bug records and source severity/priority definitions. Do not invent sprint capacity, assignment, reproducibility or a missing bug. Trend mode remains read-only; propose changes with the relevant authorization rather than silently editing bugs or backlog.
